name: achieved_porosity
source_citation: Rounded, conservative literature-informed prior. Order-of-magnitude support: Crouch et al. (ASTM STP, 2012) repeated pervious-concrete fresh-void testing, void-content CVs ~1.1-3.6% across mixes (sub-1pp scatter at ~20-25% void levels, not several pp); external controlled-compaction studies (e.g. Mitrosz et al., Sci Rep 2025) showing porosity sensitivity to vibration/compaction of order fractions of a pp per unit change in compaction condition.
double_counting_notes: Represents residual achieved-porosity uncertainty from unresolved placement/compaction/material-state effects. Do NOT add a second independent compaction random variable or porosity-measurement-error term on top of this in the baseline run (Sections E7/E8).

name: cement_mass
source_citation: Conservative process envelope informed by concrete batching-scale accuracy guidance (NRMCA/ASTM C94-class scale-accuracy criteria); not itself a standard-prescribed stochastic SD.
double_counting_notes: w/c is always DERIVED from perturbed C_actual and W_actual; never sampled independently.

name: added_water
source_citation: Conservative process envelope informed by water-meter/batching accuracy guidance.
double_counting_notes: wc_actual = W_actual / C_actual recomputed AFTER cement and water perturbation; w/c is never independently randomized. Residual aggregate free-moisture impact is folded into the wide (+/-3%) sensitivity scenario rather than given its own baseline distribution -- no repeated project moisture data exist (data gap; recommend ASTM C566/C127-style measurement before physical batching).

name: aggregate_bin_masses
source_citation: Conservative process envelope informed by aggregate-scale weighing accuracy guidance.
double_counting_notes: Realised gradation fractions are DERIVED from perturbed bin masses; no second independent fraction noise is added on top (would double count weighing error and can violate simplex closure).

name: sand_mass
double_counting_notes: If nominal sand is exactly 0, S_actual is held EXACTLY 0 (no noise-created material).

name: superplasticizer
source_citation: Conservative process envelope informed by admixture-dispenser accuracy guidance.
double_counting_notes: If nominal SP == 0, SP_actual is held EXACTLY 0 in every scenario draw.

name: gradation_stockpile_mode_B
source_citation: Numerical fallback envelope, not fitted to repeated project sieve data.
distribution: logistic-normal in ALR coordinates, sensitivity-only fallback ~1pp SD per major fraction capped ~3pp (stress ~2pp capped ~5pp), closure preserved
double_counting_notes: Not used for the primary 90% reliability claim; mode A (bin-mass-derived) is the active baseline.

name: compaction
source_citation: No validated mapping from compaction effort to model inputs exists for this project.
distribution: no independent compaction random variable in baseline; represented through achieved_porosity
double_counting_notes: Introducing a second independent compaction variable alongside the full achieved-porosity term would double count the same physical mechanism (Section E7).

name: porosity_measurement_error
source_citation: Reserved for future laboratory validation planning (Section E8).
distribution: observation-layer only; NOT added to latent true porosity used in the manufacturing reliability calculation
double_counting_notes: Must not be double-counted into the robust search; discussed only, never sampled here.

name: strength_permeability_measurement_error
source_citation: Paired cross-fitted out-of-sample residuals (repeated random row splits, same-row excluded) already combine modelling, between-study and observation variability.
distribution: additional optimiser noise = 0 when paired predictive-residual sampling is active
double_counting_notes: Adding a separate generic measurement CV on top of the paired residual distribution would double count.
